description_en: Disables a rule. After a rule is disabled, the resource in the rule is no longer evaluated. The compliance evaluation results before the rule is disabled are still displayed
description_zh: 停用规则后，不再对资源进行评估，仍显示停用前的合规评估结果
kebab_example: aliyun config deactive-config-rules --config-rule-ids cr-19a56457e0d900580000 --compliance-pack-id cp-fe416457e0d900220000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeactiveConfigRules

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the rule. Separate multiple rule IDs with commas (,).

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a rule, see [ListConfigRules](~~169607~~).
